objective: Fix inaccurate Matthew Henry Filipino translation at 1 Kings 3:5 by clarifying theological English idioms before Google on-device ML Kit, repairing verified bad machine output, preserving citations and original English, and refusing known unsafe translations.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current GitHub main 3b488fa704b804f05c5a289a7e0775daeabb2404, featuring v3 Henry translation and Nov16 production staging parity RC. Live staging/production manifests and actual Android behavior have not been verified in this change; screenshot from Android shows paid-visit-as-payment, account-as-bank account, malformed communion, offered-as-invited and altar word order.
chosenApproach: Limit changes to the existing Henry translator and its Bible reader disclaimer. Rewrite only narrowly verified English source clauses before offline ML Kit, apply source-specific Filipino repairs after translation, validate Biblical book/chapter/verse citations and high-risk semantic hazards before caching under v4, otherwise show authoritative English. Preserve the Google attribution and account-scoped offline cache. No remote translation API.
selectionRationale: A new cloud translator or whole-commentary AI rewrite would add cost, privacy risk, uncited paraphrase, and possible hallucinations. Narrow source-aware idioms with fail-closed fallback address observed failures without changing Bible text, verses, data sources, navigation or AdMob.
alternativeApproaches: Blindly rewrite all translated prose with dictionary word substitutions: rejected because it can corrupt theology and ordinary financial phrases.
Automatically claim all machine output is fully accurate: rejected because general-purpose ML Kit translation cannot certify doctrinal equivalence.
Publish current PR directly to production without exact runtime and ad/navigation gates: rejected.
preserveBehaviors: Matthew Henry public-domain original English is retained byte-for-byte and is always accessible.
Only the optional on-device commentary translation receives English idiom clarification; Scripture text, Strong's and daily reading remain unchanged.
Retain verse-specific source provenance and citations; no invented commentary or missing references accepted as Filipino.
Keep explicit user action, official Google Translate badge and link, English fallback on unavailable models and account-scoped cache.
AdMob fill and display, app-wide navigation, dashboard performance, finance, production Supabase and native runtime remain unchanged.
No staging or production OTA, EAS build, signed package, environment, or backend mutation in this source PR.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Optional commentary translator source and its account-scoped cache are updated with v4 grammar and semantic safeguards.
preservedBehaviors: Keep existing offline account-scoped ML Kit translation, English source fallback, and all unrelated app runtime behavior.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Bible reader commentary disclosure is corrected to avoid overstating machine translation accuracy while preserving Bible reading.
preservedBehaviors: Preserve Bible reader, verse anchors, original Matthew Henry English, citations, offline Scripture and Strong's links.

acceptanceChecks: Focused HTML/JS semantic tests cover exact screenshot 1 Kings 3:5 text and repaired Google ML Kit output, fail closed on known wrong meanings and missing Bible citations.
Bible reader displays original English if translation is unsupported or rejected, and truthful attribution if successful.
Protected-feature gate and Engineering Accountability pass with this exact V2 changed-path manifest.
TypeScript and staging Android runtime 1.3.2 actual source verified with device visual and regression checks before any OTA.
Production promotion, if authorized later, requires exact frozen RC, compatibility, AdMob/nav and post-publish live manifest readback.
